answer: Retiring an identity early forfeits 43% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the terrace forfeiture publishes up in the trellis totals with the crystal audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 21 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
